license_label: ImageNet access terms — non-commercial research and educational use
evidence: The canonical ImageNet access/download pages explicitly restrict database/image-data use to non-commercial research and educational purposes and impose additional terms. These are preserved as non-SPDX access/reuse terms rather than mapped to an open-data licence.

The canonical COCO portal exposes a Terms of Use surface, but no single dataset-wide SPDX licence covering all image and annotation content was independently established in this checkpoint. No universal licence is inferred from public downloads or downstream packages.

CR000353 resolves to the FCLAB institutional resource already represented by CR000346. No site-level reuse licence was independently verified, and no licence is inferred from the institution's public accessibility.
